description: This Java source file defines an Android service named IncomingRequestWearService that extends WearableListenerService. It handles incoming messages related to permissions and sensor data requests from a paired phone device. The service processes message events, prompts the user for sensor permissions, responds with sensor information, and communicates back to the phone using GoogleApiClient and Wearable APIs.

classes.name: IncomingRequestWearService
classes.description: An Android WearableListenerService that handles incoming data and permission requests from a connected phone, facilitating communication between the watch and phone regarding sensor permissions and data sharing.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, parses their path and data, and initiates appropriate responses for permission prompts or data requests.

methods.name: promptUserForSensorPermission
methods.description: Checks if sensor permissions are granted; if not, starts an activity to prompt the user.

methods.name: respondWithSensorInformation
methods.description: Responds with sensor data if permissions are granted; otherwise, indicates that permission is required.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message back to the phone device using the Wearable APIs, handling capability discovery and message transmission.

methods.name: pickBestNodeId
methods.description: Chooses the most suitable connected node (preferably nearby) for communication.
